repairs.before: That year, Emperor Cheng sent attendants Xu Meng, Lüqiu Xing, and others bearing credentials to appoint Huang General Who Guards the Army, governor of Ping Province, Great Shanyu, Duke of Liaodong; bearer of credentials, overall commander, investiture by mandate on the model of Hui’s precedent.
repairs.after: That year, Emperor Cheng sent the yezhe Xu Meng, Lüqiu Xing, and others bearing credentials to appoint Huang General Who Guards the Army, governor of Ping Province, Great Shanyu, and Duke of Liaodong; with credentials, overall command, and authority to make appointments under imperial mandate, just as in Hui’s precedent.
repairs.sourceQuote: 是歲，成帝遣謁者徐孟、閭丘幸等持節拜皝鎮軍大將軍、平州刺史、大單于、遼東公，持節、都督、承制封拜，一如廆故事。
repairs.reason: Idiomatic omits 遣謁者徐孟、閭丘幸等持節 and collapses 持節、都督、承制封拜; literal mistranslates 謁者 as “attendants.”

repairs.before: That year Emperor Cheng invested him as general who guards the army, governor of Pingzhou, great shanyu, and duke of Liaodong, with full authority to enfeoff subordinates as Hui had held.
repairs.after: That year Emperor Cheng sent the envoys Xu Meng, Lüqiu Xing, and others with credentials to invest Huang as General Who Guards the Army, governor of Ping Province, great shanyu, and duke of Liaodong, with credentials, overall command, and authority to enfeoff by mandate, as Hui had held.
repairs.sourceQuote: 是歲，成帝遣謁者徐孟、閭丘幸等持節拜皝鎮軍大將軍、平州刺史、大單于、遼東公，持節、都督、承制封拜，一如廆故事。
repairs.reason: Idiomatic omits 遣謁者徐孟、閭丘幸等持節 and collapses 持節、都督、承制封拜; literal mistranslates 謁者 as “attendants.”

repairs.before: Thereupon executed Ren’s placed guardians and magistrates, divided and moved great clans of Liaodong to Jicheng, established the three counties of Heyang, Wuci, and Xile, and returned.
repairs.after: Thereupon he executed the guardians and magistrates Ren had installed, moved the great clans of Liaodong in groups to Jicheng, established the three counties of Heyang, Wuci, and Xile, and returned.
repairs.sourceQuote: 於是斬仁所置守宰，分徙遼東大姓於棘城，置和陽、武次、西樂三縣而歸。
repairs.reason: Idiomatic omits the county names 和陽、武次、西樂; literal lacks an explicit subject for 斬 and is slightly stiffened for parallel use.

repairs.before: He executed Ren’s officials, relocated the leading Liaodong families to Jicheng, set up three new counties, and marched home.
repairs.after: He executed Ren’s officials, relocated the leading Liaodong families to Jicheng, established the three counties of Heyang, Wuci, and Xile, and marched home.
repairs.sourceQuote: 於是斬仁所置守宰，分徙遼東大姓於棘城，置和陽、武次、西樂三縣而歸。
repairs.reason: Idiomatic omits the county names 和陽、武次、西樂; literal lacks an explicit subject for 斬 and is slightly stiffened for parallel use.

repairs.before: He named Feng Yi chancellor, Han Shou marshal, and distributed ministerial and command posts among Pei Kai, Yang Wu, and the rest.
repairs.after: He named Feng Yi state chancellor and Han Shou marshal, and appointed Pei Kai, Yang Wu, Wang Yu, Li Hong, Du Qun, Song Gai, Liu Zhan, Shi Cong, Huangfu Zhen, Yang Xie, Song Huang, Ping Xi, Zhang Hong and others as ministers and generals.
repairs.sourceQuote: 以封弈為國相，韓壽為司馬，裴開、陽騖、王寓、李洪、杜群、宋該、劉瞻、石琮、皇甫真、陽協、宋晃、平熙、張泓等並為列卿將帥。
repairs.reason: The English drops eleven of the thirteen names listed in 裴開、陽騖、王寓、李洪、杜群、宋該、劉瞻、石琮、皇甫真、陽協、宋晃、平熙、張泓等並為列卿將帥. This is a definite omission.

repairs.before: Jilong sent his general Ma Qiu leading host to welcome Liao; Ke ambushed seven thousand picked cavalry at Miyun Mountain, greatly defeated them, captured their marshal Yang Yu, general Xianyu Liang, and led Duan Liao and his division host back.
repairs.after: Jilong sent his general Ma Qiu leading a host to meet Liao; Ke stationed seven thousand picked cavalry in ambush at Miyun Mountain and greatly defeated them, captured their marshal Yang Yu and general Xianyu Liang, and brought Duan Liao and his followers back.
repairs.sourceQuote: 季龍遣其將麻秋率眾迎遼，恪伏精騎七千於密雲山，大敗之，獲其司馬陽裕、將軍鮮于亮，擁段遼及其部眾以歸。
repairs.reason: 恪伏精騎七千 means Ke stationed his seven thousand cavalry in ambush; the existing and worker-proposed wording can misidentify them as the enemy being ambushed. Preserve 大敗之, both captured officers, and 及其部眾.

repairs.before: Shi Hu sent Ma Qiu to fetch him; Murong Ke ambushed seven thousand elite riders at Miyun, captured Yang Yu and Xianyu Liang, and brought Duan Liao in.
repairs.after: Shi Hu sent his general Ma Qiu with troops to meet Duan Liao. Murong Ke stationed seven thousand elite cavalry in ambush at Miyun Mountain and routed them, captured marshal Yang Yu and general Xianyu Liang, and brought Duan Liao and his followers back.
repairs.sourceQuote: 季龍遣其將麻秋率眾迎遼，恪伏精騎七千於密雲山，大敗之，獲其司馬陽裕、將軍鮮于亮，擁段遼及其部眾以歸。
repairs.reason: Restore the troops, rout, officer roles, and followers; translate 伏精騎七千 as stationing seven thousand cavalry in ambush. Raw worker alternative remains preserved for independent review.

repairs.before: Although Huang styled King of Yan, there was yet no court command; thereupon sent his chief clerk Liu Xiang to present victory at the capital, concurrently stating the intent of provisional authority, and requesting a great campaign to pacify the Central Plain.
repairs.after: Although Huang styled himself King of Yan, there was yet no court mandate; he thereupon sent his chief clerk Liu Xiang to report his victory at the capital, also explaining his provisional assumption of authority and requesting a great campaign to pacify the Central Plain.
repairs.sourceQuote: 皝雖稱燕王，未有朝命，乃遣其長史劉祥獻捷京師，兼言權假之意，並請大舉討平中原。
repairs.reason: Retain 長史, 京師, 權假 and 討平中原 in both English fields. Use report his victory for 獻捷 without adding unattested spoils.

repairs.before: Though he called himself king of Yan, the court had not recognized it, so he sent Liu Xiang to report victories, explain his provisional rule, and ask for a northern expedition.
repairs.after: Though he called himself King of Yan, he still lacked a court mandate, so he sent his chief clerk Liu Xiang to report his victory at the capital, explain his provisional assumption of authority, and ask for a major campaign to pacify the Central Plain.
repairs.sourceQuote: 皝雖稱燕王，未有朝命，乃遣其長史劉祥獻捷京師，兼言權假之意，並請大舉討平中原。
repairs.reason: Restore the chief clerk and capital and the explicit campaign aim. Host amendment avoids treating 獻捷 as necessarily physical spoils.

repairs.before: Ke rode victory to pursue them, beheaded and captured over thirty thousand grades, built a fort at Fancheng and returned.
repairs.after: Ke, riding the victory, pursued them, beheaded and captured over thirty thousand heads, built a garrison at Fancheng and returned.
repairs.sourceQuote: 恪乘勝追之，斬獲三萬餘級，築戍凡城而還。
repairs.reason: Idiomatic/en omit 乘勝 and drop 餘 from 三萬餘級.

repairs.before: Murong Ke pursued, killed or captured thirty thousand, and fortified Fancheng on the withdrawal.
repairs.after: Murong Ke pressed the victory in pursuit, killed or captured over thirty thousand, built a garrison at Fancheng, and returned.
repairs.sourceQuote: 恪乘勝追之，斬獲三萬餘級，築戍凡城而還。
repairs.reason: Idiomatic/en omit 乘勝 and drop 餘 from 三萬餘級.

repairs.before: Yu Bing, terrified yet unable to coerce him from afar, joined He Chong in recommending that the court recognize the title of king of Yan.
repairs.after: On seeing the memorial and the letter, Yu Bing was greatly alarmed; because Huang was so far away and beyond his power to control, he joined He Chong and others in memorializing that Huang be allowed to style himself King of Yan.
repairs.sourceQuote: 冰見表及書甚懼，以其絕遠，非所能制，遂與何充等奏聽皝稱燕王。
repairs.reason: English omits 見表及書 (seeing the memorial and letter) and 等 (and others).

repairs.before: Thereupon led cavalry twenty thousand out Wengong Pass, long drove reaching Ji city, advanced crossed Wusui Ford, entered Gaoyang; wherever passed burned granaries, plundered and moved You and Ji over thirty thousand households.
repairs.after: Thereupon he led twenty thousand cavalry out through Yeweng Pass, drove straight to Ji city, advanced across Wusui Ford, and entered Gaoyang; wherever he passed he burned the stores, and he plundered and relocated more than thirty thousand households from You and Ji.
repairs.sourceQuote: 於是率騎二萬出蠮螉塞，長驅至於薊城，進渡武遂津，入于高陽，所過焚燒積聚，掠徙幽、冀三萬餘戶。
repairs.reason: Correct 蠮螉 as Yeweng, preserve the movement, burning and more than thirty thousand households. Literal Wengong and worker Yiweng are both unsupported by the consulted pronunciation witnesses.

repairs.before: He led twenty thousand horse through Wengong Pass, raced to Ji, crossed Wusui Ford into Gaoyang, burned depots, and carried off thirty thousand households from You and Ji.
repairs.after: He then led twenty thousand cavalry out through Yeweng Pass, drove straight to Ji city, advanced across Wusui Ford into Gaoyang, burning the stores wherever he passed, and carried off more than thirty thousand households from You and Ji.
repairs.sourceQuote: 於是率騎二萬出蠮螉塞，長驅至於薊城，進渡武遂津，入于高陽，所過焚燒積聚，掠徙幽、冀三萬餘戶。
repairs.reason: 蠮螉塞 is Yiweng Pass, not Wengong Pass; 餘 (more than) was omitted. Host amendment: Sinica gives 蠮 ye1 and Ministry of Education gives 螉 wēng, supporting Yeweng rather than worker Yiweng.

repairs.before: Murong Han shattered his army and took nearly every man alive.
repairs.after: He sent Murong Han with cavalry to strike them; Moqian Hun was badly defeated and escaped alone, while his entire host was taken captive.
repairs.sourceQuote: 遣翰率騎擊之，渾大敗，僅以身免，盡俘其眾。
repairs.reason: English omits 遣翰率騎擊之 (Huang sent Han with cavalry), 僅以身免 (escaped alone with only his person), and names neither the dispatch nor Hun’s lone flight.

repairs.before: Duan Juan, Xianbei chieftain and Jin general, sought him eagerly.
repairs.after: At that time the Xianbei chanyu Duan Juan, who held the Jin titles of General of Agile Cavalry and Duke of Liaoxi, had a refined fondness for men of talent and humbly invited Yang Yu.
repairs.sourceQuote: 時鮮卑單于段眷為晉驃騎大將軍、遼西公，雅好人物，虛心延裕。
repairs.reason: Omits the Jin titles 驃騎大將軍、遼西公 and the phrase 雅好人物/虛心延裕.

repairs.before: When Duan Liao asked Shi Hu for an escort, Yang Yu served as chief clerk under Ma Qiu.
repairs.after: When Duan Liao asked Shi Hu to send troops to receive him, Yang Yu, while serving as Left Assistant, concurrently served as marshal to Ma Qiu, General Who Campaigns in the East.
repairs.sourceQuote: 段遼之請迎于季龍也，裕以左丞領征東麻秋司馬。
repairs.reason: 司馬 is mistranslated as "chief clerk", and 以左丞領 and the title 征東 are omitted. Host amendment translates 司馬 as marshal and retains 左丞 without adding the unsupported Secretariat agency.

repairs.before: At the time of Duan Liao’s request to welcome from Jilong, Yu as left assistant concurrently led Eastern Campaign Ma Qiu’s major.
repairs.after: When Duan Liao requested that Jilong receive him, Yu, as Left Assistant, concurrently served as marshal to Ma Qiu, General Who Campaigns in the East.
repairs.sourceQuote: 段遼之請迎于季龍也，裕以左丞領征東麻秋司馬。
repairs.reason: Host paired repair restores the direction of the request and renders 以左丞領征東麻秋司馬 as a concurrent appointment under the named general.

repairs.before: Even a county post can bless one’s heirs—let alone chancellor.
repairs.after: Shaoyou said that a post as commandery clerk was enough to shelter one's descendants; how much more the post of chancellor of a state!
repairs.sourceQuote: 少遊有雲，郡掾足以廕後，況國相乎！
repairs.reason: Omits the speaker Shaoyou (少遊), and 郡掾/國相 are mistranslated as "county post"/"chancellor" without the attribution.

unchangedPairedFieldChecks.after: Made Feng Yi state chancellor, Han Shou marshal, Pei Kai, Yang Wu, Wang Yu, Li Hong, Du Qun, Song Gai, Liu Zhan, Shi Cong, Huangfu Zhen, Yang Xie, Song Huang, Ping Xi, Zhang Hong and others concurrently ministers and generals.

unchangedPairedFieldChecks.after: Shao You said, a commandery aide suffices to shade posterity—how much more a state chancellor!

context.zh: 蘭復攻柳城，為飛梯、地道，圍守二旬，石琮躬勒將士出擊，敗之，斬首千五百級，蘭乃遁歸。
context.literal: Lan again attacked Liucheng, made flying ladders and tunnels, besieged and guarded twenty days; Shi Cong personally led officers and soldiers out to strike, defeated them, beheaded fifteen hundred grades; Lan then fled and returned.
context.idiomatic: Duan Lan renewed the siege with ladders and tunnels, but after twenty days Shi Cong sallied forth, killed fifteen hundred men, and forced Lan to withdraw.

context.zh: 是歲，成帝遣謁者徐孟、閭丘幸等持節拜皝鎮軍大將軍、平州刺史、大單于、遼東公，持節、都督、承制封拜，一如廆故事。
context.literal: That year, Emperor Cheng sent attendants Xu Meng, Lüqiu Xing, and others bearing credentials to appoint Huang General Who Guards the Army, governor of Ping Province, Great Shanyu, Duke of Liaodong; bearer of credentials, overall commander, investiture by mandate on the model of Hui’s precedent.
context.idiomatic: That year Emperor Cheng invested him as general who guards the army, governor of Pingzhou, great shanyu, and duke of Liaodong, with full authority to enfeoff subordinates as Hui had held.

context.zh: 皝自征遼東，克襄平。
context.literal: Huang personally campaigned Liaodong, took Xiangping.
context.idiomatic: Huang led the army in person and captured Xiangping.

context.zh: 仁所署居就令劉程以城降，新昌人張衡執縣宰以降。
context.literal: Magistrate Liu Cheng of Juqiu, whom Ren had appointed, surrendered the city; a man of Xinchang, Zhang Heng, seized the county chief and surrendered.
context.idiomatic: Liu Cheng, whom Ren had installed at Juqiu, yielded the town, while Zhang Heng of Xinchang seized the magistrate and capitulated.

context.zh: 於是斬仁所置守宰，分徙遼東大姓於棘城，置和陽、武次、西樂三縣而歸。
context.literal: Thereupon executed Ren’s placed guardians and magistrates, divided and moved great clans of Liaodong to Jicheng, established the three counties of Heyang, Wuci, and Xile, and returned.
context.idiomatic: He executed Ren’s officials, relocated the leading Liaodong families to Jicheng, set up three new counties, and marched home.

context.zh: 咸康初，遣封弈襲宇文別部涉奕於，大獲而還。
context.literal: At the beginning of Xiankang, sent Feng Yi to raid Yuwen’s separate division Sheyiyu; great capture and return.
context.idiomatic: Early in Xiankang he sent Feng Yi against Sheyiyu of a separate Yuwen division and returned with rich spoils.

context.zh: 封弈等以皝任重位輕，宜稱燕王，皝於是以咸康三年僭即王位，赦其境內。
context.literal: Feng Yi and others because Huang’s burden was weighty yet rank was light, ought to style King of Yan; Huang thereupon in the third year of Xiankang illegitimately assumed kingship, pardoned those within his borders.
context.idiomatic: Feng Yi and others, holding that Huang’s burden was heavy while his rank was light, urged him to style himself King of Yan; Huang thereupon in the third year of Xiankang illegitimately assumed the kingship and pardoned those within his borders.

context.zh: 以封弈為國相，韓壽為司馬，裴開、陽騖、王寓、李洪、杜群、宋該、劉瞻、石琮、皇甫真、陽協、宋晃、平熙、張泓等並為列卿將帥。
context.literal: Made Feng Yi state chancellor, Han Shou marshal, Pei Kai, Yang Wu, Wang Yu, Li Hong, Du Qun, Song Gai, Liu Zhan, Shi Cong, Huangfu Zhen, Yang Xie, Song Huang, Ping Xi, Zhang Hong and others concurrently ministers and generals.
context.idiomatic: He named Feng Yi chancellor, Han Shou marshal, and distributed ministerial and command posts among Pei Kai, Yang Wu, and the rest.

context.zh: 起文昌殿，乘金根車，駕六馬，出入稱警蹕。
context.literal: Raised the Wenchang Hall, rode the gold-root carriage, harnessed six horses, going out and entering called out “clear the way.”
context.idiomatic: He built Wenchang Hall, rode the six-horse imperial carriage, and received full royal escorts.

context.zh: 季龍諸軍驚擾，棄甲而遁。
context.literal: Jilong’s various armies were alarmed and disturbed, cast armor and fled.
context.idiomatic: Shi Hu’s host panicked and bolted, leaving their armor.

context.zh: 恪乘勝追之，斬獲三萬餘級，築戍凡城而還。
context.literal: Ke rode victory to pursue them, beheaded and captured over thirty thousand grades, built a fort at Fancheng and returned.
context.idiomatic: Murong Ke pursued, killed or captured thirty thousand, and fortified Fancheng on the withdrawal.

context.zh: 段遼遣使詐降于季龍，請兵應接。
context.literal: Duan Liao sent envoys feigning surrender to Jilong, requesting troops to meet and escort.
context.idiomatic: Duan Liao feigned submission to Shi Hu and asked for an escort.

context.zh: 季龍遣其將麻秋率眾迎遼，恪伏精騎七千於密雲山，大敗之，獲其司馬陽裕、將軍鮮于亮，擁段遼及其部眾以歸。
context.literal: Jilong sent his general Ma Qiu leading host to welcome Liao; Ke ambushed seven thousand picked cavalry at Miyun Mountain, greatly defeated them, captured their marshal Yang Yu, general Xianyu Liang, and led Duan Liao and his division host back.
context.idiomatic: Shi Hu sent Ma Qiu to fetch him; Murong Ke ambushed seven thousand elite riders at Miyun, captured Yang Yu and Xianyu Liang, and brought Duan Liao in.

context.zh: 帝又遣使進皝為征北大將軍、幽州牧，領平州刺史，加散騎常侍，增邑萬戶，持節、都督、單于、公如故。
context.literal: The emperor again sent envoys to advance Huang as General Who Campaigns North, shepherd of You Province, concurrently governor of Ping Province, added Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary, increased fief ten thousand households; credentials, overall command, shanyu, duke as before.
context.idiomatic: The emperor again sent envoys to advance Huang as General Who Campaigns North, shepherd of You Province, concurrently governor of Ping Province, adding Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary and an increase of ten thousand households, with credentials, overall command, shanyu, and duke as before.

context.zh: 季龍又使石成入攻凡城，不克，進陷廣城。
context.literal: Jilong again sent Shi Cheng to attack Fancheng, could not overcome it, advanced and took Guangcheng.
context.idiomatic: Shi Hu sent Shi Cheng against Fancheng without success but seized Guangcheng.

context.zh: 皝雖稱燕王，未有朝命，乃遣其長史劉祥獻捷京師，兼言權假之意，並請大舉討平中原。
context.literal: Although Huang styled King of Yan, there was yet no court command; thereupon sent his chief clerk Liu Xiang to present victory at the capital, concurrently stating the intent of provisional authority, and requesting a great campaign to pacify the Central Plain.
context.idiomatic: Though he called himself king of Yan, the court had not recognized it, so he sent Liu Xiang to report victories, explain his provisional rule, and ask for a northern expedition.

context.zh: 又聞庾亮薨，弟冰、翼繼為將相，乃表曰：臣究觀前代昏明之主，若能親賢並建，則功致升平；
context.literal: Moreover, when he learned that Yu Liang had died and Yu Bing and Yu Yi had succeeded as generals and ministers, he submitted a memorial, saying: Your servant has closely observed the muddled and clear rulers of former ages; if they could treat the worthy with intimacy and elevate them together, then merit reached peaceful ascendancy;
context.idiomatic: When Murong Huang learned that Yu Liang had died and Yu Bing and Yu Yi held power, he submitted a memorial: I have studied wise and foolish rulers of past ages. When they favored the worthy and elevated them together, the realm rose to peace;

context.zh: 吾雖寡德，過蒙先帝列將之授，以數郡之人，尚欲併吞強虜，是以自頃迄今，交鋒接刃，一時務農，三時用武，而猶師徒不頓，倉有餘粟，敵人日畏，我境日廣，況乃王者之威，堂堂之勢，豈可同年而語哉！
context.literal: Though I am few in virtue, I have unduly received the former emperor's grant of command over the columns; with the people of several commanderies I still wish to swallow strong enemies; therefore from recently until now, clashing blades and meeting swords, one season for farming and three for war, yet the army is not exhausted, the granaries have surplus grain, the enemy daily fears us and our borders daily widen; how much more the king's majesty and stately power, how can they be spoken of in the same year!
context.idiomatic: I am little in virtue, yet the former emperor made me a column commander; with several commanderies I still mean to swallow strong foes. From lately until now I farm one season and fight three, yet my armies do not fail, my granaries hold surplus, the enemy daily fears us and our borders widen daily; how much more the majesty of a king and stately power, how can these be compared!

context.zh: 冰見表及書甚懼，以其絕遠，非所能制，遂與何充等奏聽皝稱燕王。
context.literal: Bing seeing the memorial and letter was greatly afraid; because they were extremely distant, not what they could control; thereupon with He Chong and others memorialized to permit Huang to style King of Yan.
context.idiomatic: Yu Bing, terrified yet unable to coerce him from afar, joined He Chong in recommending that the court recognize the title of king of Yan.

context.zh: 其年皝伐高句麗，王釗乞盟而還。
context.literal: That year Huang campaigned against Gaogouli; King Gao Zhao begged a covenant, and Huang returned.
context.idiomatic: That year he invaded Goguryeo; King Gao Zhao sued for peace and he withdrew.

context.zh: 皝將圖石氏，從容謂諸將曰：「石季龍自以安樂諸城守防嚴重，城之南北必不設備，今若詭路出其不意，冀之北土盡可破也。」
context.literal: Huang was about to plan the Shi clan; leisurely said to the generals: “Shi Jilong thinks the cities of Anle and the rest guard defense strict and heavy; surely north and south of the city he does not set equipment; now if by deceitful route go out where he does not expect, the whole north of Ji can be broken.”
context.idiomatic: Planning against the Shi, he told his commanders, “Shi Hu trusts his garrisons at Anle and neglects the open country north and south of the wall—a sudden raid could overrun the whole Ji plain.”

context.zh: 於是率騎二萬出蠮螉塞，長驅至於薊城，進渡武遂津，入于高陽，所過焚燒積聚，掠徙幽、冀三萬餘戶。
context.literal: Thereupon led cavalry twenty thousand out Wengong Pass, long drove reaching Ji city, advanced crossed Wusui Ford, entered Gaoyang; wherever passed burned granaries, plundered and moved You and Ji over thirty thousand households.
context.idiomatic: He led twenty thousand horse through Wengong Pass, raced to Ji, crossed Wusui Ford into Gaoyang, burned depots, and carried off thirty thousand households from You and Ji.

context.zh: 使陽裕、唐柱等築龍城，構宮廟，改柳城為龍城縣。
context.literal: Had Yang Yu, Tang Zhu, and others build Longcheng, construct palace and temples, changed Liucheng to Longcheng county.
context.idiomatic: He had Yang Yu and Tang Zhu build Longcheng, raised palaces and shrines, and renamed Liucheng county Longcheng.

context.zh: 皝曰：「渾奢忌已甚，今則可一戰矣。」
context.literal: Huang said: “Hun’s extravagance and jealousy are already extreme; now then can one battle.”
context.idiomatic: Huang said, “Moqian Hun’s arrogance has peaked—now we can strike.”

context.zh: 遣翰率騎擊之，渾大敗，僅以身免，盡俘其眾。
context.literal: Sent Han leading cavalry to strike them; Hun was greatly defeated, barely himself escaped, wholly captured their host.
context.idiomatic: Murong Han shattered his army and took nearly every man alive.

context.zh: 皝躬巡郡縣，勸課農桑，起龍城宮闕。
context.literal: Huang personally toured prefectures and counties, urged and supervised farming and sericulture, raised Longcheng palace and towers.
context.idiomatic: Murong Huang toured his domains, pushed farming and sericulture, and raised palaces at Longcheng.

context.zh: 勒方任之，裕乃微服潛遁。
context.literal: Le was about to employ him; Yu then disguised himself and slipped away.
context.idiomatic: Shi Le meant to employ Yang Yu, who fled in disguise.

context.zh: 時鮮卑單于段眷為晉驃騎大將軍、遼西公，雅好人物，虛心延裕。
context.literal: At the time Xianbei Shanyu Duan Juan was Jin’s General of Agile Cavalry and Duke of Liaoxi; by nature he loved men of talent and humbly invited Yu.
context.idiomatic: Duan Juan, Xianbei chieftain and Jin general, sought him eagerly.

context.zh: 裕謂友人成泮曰：「仲尼喜佛肸之召，以匏瓜自喻，伊尹亦稱何事非君，何使非民，聖賢尚如此，況吾曹乎！
context.literal: Yu told friend Cheng Pan, saying: “Confucius rejoiced at Bi Xi’s summons, used the gourd as metaphor; Yi Yin also said what affair is not lord, what people not subjects—even sages were thus; how much more our sort!
context.idiomatic: Yang Yu told his friend Cheng Pan, "Confucius rejoiced at Bi Xi's summons and likened himself to a gourd; Yi Yin too said, 'What affair is not that of the lord? What people are not his subjects?' Even sages were thus, how much more we!

context.zh: 古人以為白駒之歎。
context.literal: The ancients took this as the white colt’s sigh.
context.idiomatic: The ancients sighed at time’s white colt.

context.zh: 少遊有雲，郡掾足以廕後，況國相乎！
context.literal: Shao You said, a commandery aide suffices to shade posterity—how much more a state chancellor!
context.idiomatic: Even a county post can bless one’s heirs—let alone chancellor.

context.zh: 卿追蹤伊、孔，抑亦知機其神也。」
context.literal: You trace Yi and Kong, or also know the moment’s spirit.”
context.idiomatic: You follow Confucius and Yi Yin—you know when Heaven calls.”

context.zh: 石季龍克令支，裕以郡降，拜北平太守，徵為尚書左丞。
context.literal: Shi Jilong took Lingzhi; Yu with the commandery surrendered; appointed Beiping grand warden; summoned as Left Assistant to the Masters of Writing.
context.idiomatic: When Shi Hu seized Lingzhi, Yang Yu surrendered his commandery, was named grand warden of Beiping, then recalled as left assistant in the secretariat.

context.zh: 段遼之請迎于季龍也，裕以左丞領征東麻秋司馬。
context.literal: At the time of Duan Liao’s request to welcome from Jilong, Yu as left assistant concurrently led Eastern Campaign Ma Qiu’s major.
context.idiomatic: When Duan Liao asked Shi Hu for an escort, Yang Yu served as chief clerk under Ma Qiu.

context.zh: 秋敗，裕為軍人所執，將詣皝。
context.literal: When Qiu was defeated, Yu was seized by soldiers, was about to be brought to Huang.
context.idiomatic: Ma Qiu’s defeat left Yang Yu a prisoner on his way to Murong Huang.

repeatedUseContext.zh: 遣兼長史劉斌、郎中令陽景送徐孟等歸於京師。
repeatedUseContext.literal: Sent concurrent chief clerk Liu Bin, palace director Yang Jing to escort Xu Meng and others back to the capital.
repeatedUseContext.idiomatic: He sent Liu Bin and Yang Jing to escort Xu Meng’s party to the capital.
